title: Hook
line: You post every single day, your reels get views, but nobody books a call with you.
visual: YOUR REELS GET VIEWS. BUT (white justified kicker) / NO CALLS. (yellow, faint letterpress grain) + hand-painted blue brush underline under CALLS. Halftone ghost word VIEWS sits behind the speaker's head (chroma key), big and hollow.
motion: Kicker blurs in on frame 1, headline blur-scales in at 0.45s; brush underline paints on 'nobody' (4.75) with a punch-in. Ghost VIEWS settles slowly behind the hair. Everything exits up with blur at 7.1, after 'you.'.

title: Series tile
line: Welcome to Coach Meet Business Series where I break down…
visual: Paper tile ep. 07, the same tile system as ep.03–06 (coach meet / business / series with blue bar, footer 'Building a ₹1 crore business, step by step').
motion: Tile cuts in at 7.45; 07 rises on 'Welcome' (7.57); 'coach meet' on 'Coach' (8.46), 'business' on 'Business' (9.34), bar + 'series' on 'Series' (9.94); tile wipes up on 'where' (10.45). Captions hidden while it is up.

title: 1 crore
line: …what it takes to build a ₹1 crore coaching business. (transcript: 'one-core')
visual: WHAT IT TAKES TO BUILD A / ₹1 CRORE (yellow) / coaching business. (series line, unchanged).
motion: Kicker word-by-word on what/it/takes/to/build/a (12.08–14.09); ₹1 CRORE blur-scales in on 'one-core' (14.38) with a punch-in; serif on 'coaching' (14.93); out at 16.05.

title: They think
line: So most coaches think that the problem is consistency. They think if I just post more, someone will eventually buy.
visual: Label column: THEY THINK (blue small caps) | rule | “the problem is consistency.” (outline row) / “if I just post more…” (outline row with two faint echo outlines stacked under it) / white serif …someone will eventually buy + blue ?. No yellow: the belief is wrong, so yellow is saved for TRUST.
motion: Rule draws; label and row 1 land on 'consistency' (19.93); row 2 on 'post' (22.94) and on 'more' (23.36) two echo copies cascade beneath it (more posts, same row); serif on 'someone' (23.93); blue ? pops on 'buy' (25.60). Exits at 26.0, before 'But'.

title: Views are not trust
visual: BUT VIEWS ARE NOT (white kicker) / TRUST. (big yellow). Ghost word TRUST behind the speaker's head.
motion: Kicker words on 'But / views / are / not' (26.32–27.54); TRUST. blur-scales in on 'trust' (27.91) with a hard punch-in (116%); ghost settles on the same word. Out at 29.15.

title: Six months, no way up
line: People can watch you for six months and still not believe that you can solve their problem.
visual: New diagram, behind the speaker: a ground line with a blue halftone mound labelled 6 MONTHS OF VIEWS; on the right a sheer white wall up to a ledge labelled THE CALL (still dashed). Between them a dashed blue dimension line labelled TRUST, empty: the height nobody can climb. Hand-drawn shimmer on the wall and ledge. No yellow.
motion: Ground draws and the mound rises on 'watch' (29.61); it swells on 'six' (30.83) and the label becomes 6 MONTHS OF VIEWS on 'months' (31.20); wall and ledge draw up on 'still' (32.09), THE CALL on 'not' (32.55); the empty TRUST dimension draws on 'believe' (32.93). Slow float; out at 36.1.

title: Something random
line: One day it is mindset, the next day it is a morning routine, the next day it is a motivational quote. Nothing connects.
visual: New diagram, behind: three loose ribs (short white line-art arrows with light heads) labelled MINDSET, MORNING ROUTINE, MOTIVATIONAL QUOTE, lying at unrelated angles and heights, each pointing a different way, no backbone. White serif: nothing connects. No yellow.
motion: Each rib drops and settles at its own angle on its word: 'mindset' (42.50), 'morning' (45.32), 'motivational' (48.69). On 'Nothing' (50.29) a dashed blue connector starts from MINDSET toward MORNING ROUTINE and gives out halfway; serif on 'connects' (50.84); ribs drift a few px apart. Out at 51.4.

title: B-roll: in their mind
line: So in the mind of your audience, you are entertaining, but you are not the expert for one specific problem.
visual: Full-screen cutaway, dark paper-textured page: IN THEIR MIND (blue small caps); a large dry-brush target with faint halftone in the outer band. A blue YOU dot sits out on the outer band, labelled ENTERTAINING. The bullseye is empty: THE EXPERT / FOR ONE PROBLEM inside a dashed ring that turns yellow. White serif at the bottom: entertaining, not the expert.
motion: Page slides up on 'audience' (54.00); rings draw in; the YOU dot drops onto the outer band on 'you' (54.75); ENTERTAINING on 'entertaining' (55.50); serif on 'not' (57.55); THE EXPERT appears in the empty centre on 'expert' (58.30); on 'specific' (59.56) the bullseye ring turns yellow and FOR ONE PROBLEM lands, while the dot stays far out. Page slides away up at 60.3.

title: A content spine
line: What you need is a content spine. Pick the one transformation you deliver…
visual: Callback, then a new construction, behind: the loose ribs return, a long blue dry-brush backbone paints straight through them (A CONTENT SPINE, small caps), the old ribs fall away, and a yellow head appears at the spine's right end: THE ONE / TRANSFORMATION (ink on yellow).
motion: Old ribs fade back in place on 'content' (62.90); the spine paints left→right on 'spine' (63.45); on 'Pick' (64.27) the old ribs drop off and fade; the yellow head pops on 'transformation' (65.44) with a small push-in.

title: Every post a proof point
line: …make every post a proof point of that transformation. A client result, a mistake you see again and again, a framework you use on calls.
visual: Same spine: three white ribs clicked onto it, every arrowhead angled at the yellow head. Their tails are named in small caps: CLIENT RESULT / A MISTAKE YOU SEE / YOUR CALL FRAMEWORK.
motion: Ribs slide in on 'every' (68.18) and click onto the spine on 'proof' (69.35), arrowheads drawing at the joint; head pulses on 'transformation.' (71.03). Names blur in on 'client' (72.54), 'mistake' (73.99; the rib nudges toward the head on each 'again'), 'framework' (77.04).

title: Trust compounds
line: When every post points to the same outcome, trust compounds.
visual: Same spine, multiplied: 3 → 6 → 12 ribs, all pointing at the head; the spine's halftone sheath thickens toward the head and the head grows. White serif replaces the label: trust compounds.
motion: Names dim and three more ribs click on at 'every' (80.00); a light pulse runs down every rib and along the spine into the head on 'points' (80.88), arriving on 'outcome' (82.52); on 'compounds' (83.69) six more ribs cascade on, the head swells ×1.12, the serif lands; push-in. Out at 84.4.

title: The obvious next step
line: And when trust compounds, the call becomes the obvious next step, not a cold ask.
visual: Callback of the ledge: same mound of views, same wall. Now three halftone-blue steps climb the wall's face, the TRUST line is solid, and THE CALL ledge has turned yellow, exactly one step above the top step. White serif: the obvious next step. Small caps: NOT A COLD ASK.
motion: Diagram fades back in as left on 'And' (84.68); steps slide up and land one on another on 'compounds' (85.94, 0.18s apart) while the TRUST dimension turns solid; THE CALL fills yellow on 'call' (87.11); serif on 'obvious' (88.46); a small light blue arrow draws from the top step onto the ledge on 'step' (89.44) with a push-in; NOT A COLD ASK on 'cold' (90.67).

title: Does it prove it?
line: So before you post again tomorrow, ask yourself, does this post prove that I can solve that one problem?
visual: Callback of the finished spine (12 ribs, yellow head). BEFORE YOU POST, ASK (blue small caps). A new dashed white rib, TOMORROW'S POST, hovers above the spine at a loose angle with a blue ?.
motion: Spine returns on 'ask' (94.66); TOMORROW'S POST drops in and hovers on 'does' (95.79); ? pops on 'prove' (97.05); the rib swings toward the spine's angle on 'solve' (98.59) and the head pulses on 'one' (99.48), which is the test. On 'not' (101.09) it greys out and falls away below the spine.

title: Don't post it
line: If not, do not post it.
visual: DON'T POST IT. (yellow, centred), alone on the frame; the rejected rib has just fallen out of shot.
motion: Hard punch-in (to 118%) on 'do' (101.61); DON'T lands on 'do', POST on 'post' (102.32), IT. on 'it' (102.74); exits at 103.2.

title: CTA
line: Comment the word spine and I will send you my content spine template for free.
visual: COMMENT THE WORD / S P I N E yellow key-caps / & I'll send you my template, for free. Ghost word SPINE behind the speaker's head.
motion: Kicker words on 'Comment / the / word' (103.42–104.35); keys drop in one by one from 'SPINE' (104.77, 0.07s apart); serif on 'send' (106.31); ghost settles behind the hair.
